name: Uchi no Imouto no Baai (Heart)
original_name: うちの妹のばあい（はあと）
source: When Tatsuya was a child, his biological father abandoned him and his mother because she was always ill and had to stay in the hospital for a long time. Then she married to another patient at the hospital who was Yuuka's father. A few year later, they passed away and Tatsuya had to take care of Yuuka. They had been very close as children but when they grew older, their relationship gradually changed. Yuuka began to call Tatsuya "aniki" instead of "onii-chan" and she treated him coldly. Tatsuya even gave up his dream to become a professional baseball player to be always by her side before. Now what can he do to return to their "good" old days?
translation: 达也小时候，生父因为母亲常年患病、不得不长期住院而抛弃了他们。后来，母亲嫁给了医院里的另一名病人，也就是优香的父亲。几年后，两位家长相继去世，达也只好照顾优香。他们小时候关系十分亲密，但长大后，两人的关系逐渐发生了变化。优香开始称呼达也为“阿尼基”，不再叫他“哥哥”，对他的态度也变得冷淡。达也甚至为了陪在她身边，放弃了成为职业棒球选手的梦想。如今，他该怎样才能让两人回到过去那段“美好”的时光？
